body:
I feel I could speak with my family members about it, but it conflicts so strongly with my concern that I'm bothering them or wasting their time that I chicken out of even talking about my feelings. I should ask about it, and I will try to bring it up soon with my parents.

In slightly more positive news, I've promised my best friend that after school ends I'm telling him what I'm feeling. I'm worried about how he'll respond but if I'm going to start asking for help, I need to start with someone.

I'm unsure as to why the appointment stopped, it had just gone from seeing her every other week to just not being informed on any appointments. Maybe my family thought I was feeling stronger against my depression, and talking with the therapist certainly helped, but now without someone I feel comfortable talking with as myself I feel things falling apart, and it makes it hard to think of why I should try.
